assumptions.weights: iid centered Gaussian with variance C_W per paper Appendix B

symbolic.claim: For every positive-homogeneous scalar activation and every finite depth, every 1/n^k correction (k>=1) to the bias-free MLP NTK mean diagonal is zero
symbolic.classification_lemma: On R, positive homogeneity implies sigma(z)=a_plus*z for z>0 and sigma(z)=a_minus*z for z<0 (the value at zero is null-set).

induction_schema.conclusion: Theta_correction(k, layer=l)=0 for every finite l
induction_schema.quantifier: for every k>=1 and layer l>=1

empirical.claim: At exact five-million-initialization scale, four-layer bias-free ReLU and LeakyReLU diagonal NTK means equal their infinite-width values
empirical.common_random_numbers: ReLU and LeakyReLU share each Gaussian initialization and probe; networks remain iid within each activation
empirical.estimator_deviation: Unbiased two-probe parameter-space Hutchinson estimator replaces the paper implementation's exact recursive Jacobian trace

verifier.claim: Fresh four-layer GeLU NTK means at widths above 20 agree more closely with the paper's first-order recursion curve than with infinite width
At C_W=2, a bias-free width-200 ReLU MLP has linearly scaling mean NTK through depth 30; away from C_W=2 it is exponentially unstable
